data.summary:
**When:** [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), in its Reinforcements step.

**Target:** A **LEAGUES OF VOTANN** unit of yours in Reserves that has **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)**.

**Effect:** When the unit is set up using **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)** in the phase, you can place it anywhere on the battlefield over 6" horizontally from every enemy unit.

**Restrictions:** The unit cannot declare a charge for the rest of the turn.

restrictions: cannot declare a charge for the rest of the turn
